race.description: Racing On Melbourne Cup Day Hcp (55)
race.comment: Former NSW galloper BRITISH GEM (9) shed the maiden tag over this track and trip when having the first run for the new stable and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Winning rider Whiteley sticks in the saddle and can go back-to-back without surprising. VOUCHERS (5) has a win and a second from two attempts over this course and distance and will be ready to peak now third run back from the break. Watch for a spike in form. REDLIGHTS ON (3) has won three from six over this distance range and is better than the last effort suggests. Can bounce back. BUBBLES'N'FROTH (2) boasts a win around this circuit and will be rock-hard fit for this. May trouble the judge with any luck in running. ABATED BREATH (1) has put back-to-back wins together in lesser grade and shouldn't be underestimated.
